sources.title: U.S. Department of Education College Scorecard

release.label: Most Recent Institution-Level Data — June 10, 2026
release.policy: Use the official featured most-recent institution-level bulk file; retain metric-specific reporting/reference periods in downstream documentation.

authentication.mechanism: none for official featured bulk download

sources.license_or_terms: U.S. Department of Education public data; follow current College Scorecard/API terms.
sources.refresh_policy: Check the official College Scorecard data page at least monthly; update the dated featured-download URL and release metadata when the Department publishes a new file.
sources.retrieval_mode: Official featured institution-level bulk ZIP. Direct download when permitted; otherwise ingest a user-supplied copy of that same official ZIP with --source-file. No API key required.
qa: UNITID is non-null and unique in the normalized institution table.
Bulk ZIP contains an institution CSV with UNITID, INSTNM, CONTROL, and ICLEVEL.
PrivacySuppressed and null values normalize to null rather than numeric zero.
Consumer-facing completion, retention, and net-price compatibility fields are derived only from documented Scorecard bulk variables.
Scorecard absence never removes an otherwise eligible IPEDS institution from the matcher universe.
No metric loses its reporting/reference-year context in downstream documentation.
transport_notes: The official June 10, 2026 featured institution ZIP is the canonical bulk source.
As observed on 2026-10-04, ed-public-download.scorecard.network returns HTTP 403 to GitHub-hosted Actions runners even with browser-compatible headers.
This is treated as a transport limitation, not a source-validation failure. Use --source-file with an official Scorecard bulk ZIP when direct automated retrieval is blocked.
Do not substitute an unofficial mirror as production-core data solely to bypass the official host restriction.

sources.title: IPEDS 2025 Directory / Institutional Characteristics

release.label: 2025 provisional
release.policy: Use the latest available provisional release for current institution structure; replace with final release when published and record release type.

sources.refresh_policy: Annual, with provisional-to-final replacement tracked as a new source snapshot.
qa: UNITID is non-null and unique.
Institution names are nonblank for active rows.
Release type is explicitly provisional or final.
No cross-year field is silently mixed into a single row.

verification.method: GitHub Actions live ingestion + coverage audit

sources.title: IPEDS 2025 Completions by 6-digit CIP and award level

release.label: 2024-25 completions, 2025 provisional release
release.policy: Use C2025_A for current program completions; preserve release type and collection period.

qa: UNITID and CIPCODE are non-null.
CIPCODE normalizes to a 6-digit CIP representation.
Completions are nonnegative or valid source suppression/missing codes.
Rows aggregate consistently within UNITID + CIPCODE + AWLEVEL after demographic dimensions are handled explicitly.

sources.title: NCES/BLS 2020 CIP to 2018 SOC Crosswalk
sources.agency: NCES and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics

release.label: CIP 2020 ↔ SOC 2018
release.policy: Treat as a versioned qualitative many-to-many crosswalk; replace only with an official successor.

qa: CIP6 is exactly six digits after punctuation removal.
SOC6 is exactly six digits after punctuation removal.
Duplicate identical CIP6-SOC6 pairs are removed.
Many-to-many cardinality is preserved.
The bridge is never interpreted as observed graduate outcomes.

verification.method: GitHub Actions live ingestion smoke test

sources.title: O*NET Database 31.0

release.policy: Pin production snapshots to an O*NET release; upgrade deliberately after schema and join validation.

sources.license_or_terms: O*NET database is available under a Creative Commons license; retain required attribution.
sources.retrieval_mode: Official O*NET 31.0 CSV files downloaded individually from the O*NET database directory.
qa: ONET_SOC_CODE is non-null and valid.
Base SOC6 mapping is explicit and versioned.
Element IDs and scale IDs are retained where supplied.
Essential, transferable, and software skills remain separate tables.
Occupation table has one row per ONET_SOC_CODE.
All configured O*NET 31.0 file URLs are recorded with individual SHA-256 hashes.

verification.method: GitHub Actions live ingestion + career coverage audit

career_preference_governance.soc_policy: Use only .00 base O*NET-SOC rows for SOC6 alignment; do not average specialty profiles.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Education DAPIP accreditation bulk export
sources.agency: U.S. Department of Education, Office of Postsecondary Education

release.label: live DAPIP bulk export
release.policy: Retrieve the current official-site CSV bulk export as a timestamped snapshot. The site front-end endpoint is undocumented, so schema/member changes must fail closed and be reviewed before production use.

sources.license_or_terms: U.S. Department of Education public accreditation data; verify current DAPIP terms and institution-specific records for high-stakes use.
sources.refresh_policy: Refresh with each production data build or when accreditation coverage is used; retain immutable snapshots because the export is generated live.
sources.retrieval_mode: POST JSON to the bulk-download endpoint used by the official DAPIP Download Files interface with CSVChecked=true and ExcelChecked=false.
qa: ZIP contains InstitutionCampus.csv, AccreditationRecords.csv, and AccreditationActions.csv.
DAPIP identifiers remain distinct from IPEDS UNITID.
One-to-many DAPIP-to-IPEDS mappings are preserved.
Institutional and programmatic accreditation records remain distinguishable.
Current-status derivation remains explicit and does not replace institution-specific verification.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Projections Data 2025–2035

release.policy: Pin to the annual projection cycle and replace only after validating code/schema changes.

sources.retrieval_mode: Official BLS Occupational Projections HTML database; parser retains detailed occupation rows and 2025–2035 outlook fields. The downloadable Table 1.2 XLSX remains a documented reference but is not required by CI.
qa: SOC6 is valid for detailed occupations.
Total/all-occupation summary row is identified and excluded from detailed occupation joins by default.
Employment/opening units remain in thousands and are named explicitly.
Growth percent is numeric where reported.
Education/work-experience/training categories remain categorical.
Fields absent from the live database table remain null rather than inferred.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics — May 2025 national baseline

release.label: May 2025
release.policy: Pin to annual OEWS release; retain source suppression flags and geography codes.

sources.refresh_policy: Annual OEWS release; national automation-safe baseline first, with state/metro/nonmetro geography expansion retained as a separate layer.
sources.retrieval_mode: Official BLS OEWS query services under data.bls.gov/OESServices. Query May 2025 release 2025A01 for National area 0000000, cross-industry 000000, batching detailed occupations below query-size limits.
qa: National AREA + detailed OCC_CODE is unique in normalized output.
May 2025 release key 2025A01 is confirmed by the live BLS year service.
Only cross-industry 000000 and National area 0000000 enter the automation-safe baseline.
Only source displayLevel=3 occupations enter detailed joins.
Suppressed or otherwise unreported wage/employment values remain null with a status or footnote state.
Annual P25 <= median <= P75 where all three estimates are reported.

sources.title: IPEDS 2025 Institutional Characteristics — educational offerings, services, and athletics

release.label: Fall 2025 provisional
release.policy: Use the latest provisional IC release for current services/program characteristics; replace deliberately when final data become available.

sources.refresh_policy: Annual, provisional-to-final replacement tracked as a new source snapshot.
qa: UNITID is non-null and unique.
Disability-services registration evidence preserves the source's band/percentage semantics and is never treated as a physical-accessibility score.
Distance-education/service indicators preserve source missingness and reporting context.
No missing service field is converted to false.

sources.title: IPEDS 2024-25 Cost component

release.label: 2024-25 Cost component
release.policy: Use the 2024-25 Cost component for cost-of-attendance and average-net-price fields introduced or relocated in the 2024-25 collection redesign. Preserve file stem, component, collection year, and metric vintage at field level.

sources.refresh_policy: Annual; replace only after mapping and regression checks for the next Cost collection.
sources.retrieval_mode: IPEDS Complete Data Files; retain COST1/COST2/derived-cost provenance instead of flattening the component boundary.
qa: UNITID is non-null.
Cost of attendance remains distinct from tuition/fees and average net price.
Income-band average net prices remain distinct published averages and are never converted into personalized estimates.
Component and collection-year provenance survive normalization.
Suppressed, missing, unresolved, and zero values remain distinguishable.

sources.title: IPEDS Student Financial Aid — 2023-24 awards

release.label: 2023-24 Student Financial Aid
release.policy: Use SFA for grant/scholarship, loan, Federal Work-Study, and other source-specific aid evidence. Cost-of-attendance and average-net-price measures belong to the Cost component in the redesigned 2024-25 collection; preserve component and award-period provenance at field level.

qa: Aid types remain distinct by source and financing type.
Institutional grants/scholarships are not conflated with federal or state/local aid.
Loans are not subtracted when displaying average net price.
Aid recipient shares and average award amounts retain their source cohort definition.
Observed zero, missing, suppressed, and not-published states remain distinguishable.
Aid recipient counts/shares are not treated as guarantees of individual eligibility.
Federal/state aid is not mislabeled as institution-funded aid.
Component and collection-year provenance survive normalization.

sources.title: Bureau of Transportation Statistics National Transit Map
sources.agency: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics

release.label: current National Transit Map snapshot
release.policy: Capture a dated snapshot for each production build; derived campus measures must retain snapshot date, radius, and distance method.

sources.license_or_terms: U.S. DOT/BTS public data; preserve source attribution and snapshot metadata.
sources.refresh_policy: Refresh for production releases when the NTM/NTAD snapshot changes; retain immutable build snapshots.
qa: Campus coordinates and transit features use an explicit coordinate reference system.
Nearest-stop distance and stop-count radius are documented.
Transit proximity is not represented as proof of accessible vehicles, stations, sidewalks, or paths.
Missing transit coverage remains unknown rather than zero unless absence is established by the selected source universe.

sources.title: EPA National Walkability Index / Smart Location Database v3

release.label: 2021 National Walkability Index / Smart Location Database v3
release.policy: Use only as explicitly vintage-labeled 2021 built-environment/location-efficiency evidence. Do not present the 2021 index as current conditions, transit access, or physical accessibility.

sources.refresh_policy: Version-driven; replace only when EPA publishes an official successor.
qa: Institution-to-block-group assignment is deterministic and documented.
NatWalkInd remains a relative walkability index, not a physical-accessibility score.
The 2021 vintage is visible in product metadata and explanations.
Missing geography or unmatched institutions remain unknown.
Walkability remains distinct from transit proximity and physical-accessibility evidence.
Missing coverage remains unknown and is never converted into inaccessible or unwalkable.

join_contracts.rule: Never fuzzy-match institution names when UNITID is available.
Preserve all valid CIP-SOC mappings; never choose a single occupation solely to force uniqueness.
Map O*NET-SOC detail to base SOC6 explicitly; exclude BLS summary rows from detailed joins.
Preserve geography; never collapse national/state/metro rows without an explicit aggregation request.

Join only through UNITIDs explicitly supplied in DAPIP IpedsUnitIds; explode the multi-ID field into a many-to-many bridge, retain DAPIP IDs separately, and never fuzzy-name match as a production repair.
Join by UNITID only; preserve Cost reporting years separately from the current directory vintage.
Join by UNITID only; retain aid award-period context and never label older aid data as current-year awards.
Join by UNITID only; service evidence remains descriptive context, not a quality score.
Use explicit geospatial distance/radius logic from institution coordinates to NTM stop/route features; preserve no-data separately from no-nearby-service.
Assign institution coordinates to the EPA block group deterministically; retain 2021 vintage and never interpret walkability as physical accessibility.
